policy.generation: Call pinned Code/initial.py::initialize_relations through tools/official_reproduction.py agentsafe-relations
policy.pair_semantics: symmetric, uniform choice among Family/Friend/Colleague/Stranger for each unordered pair
policy.seed_rule: same declared run seed 42..56; freeze one policy per seed and share across models/topologies
host_adaptations: Operational agent IDs 0..7 and names Agent_0..Agent_7
No unavailable original random realization is claimed

criteria.origin: independently authored candidate; not supplied by AgentSafe authors

admission.score: minimum over all criterion cosine similarities
admission.theta_origin: frozen independent CSQA train development calibration, not an original author parameter

encoder.source: shared benchmark embedding service; model substitution
encoder.input: unmodified UTF-8 record and criterion text, no extra query prefix
encoder.checkpoint_revision_requirement: unrecovered; served ID and frozen criterion geometry validated, not weights-level identity

deployment_canary.purpose: numeric deployment check, not the admission score threshold
deployment_canary.rule: 2*M, pre-fixed cap 0.002, independently validated after freeze

reflection.origin: Algorithm 1 places detection within each interaction round; original measured experiment cadence not separately disclosed
reflection.decision: independently implemented judge prompt using criteria and holder-local junk
reflection.released_code_difference: released ReviewMemory checks individual lines and deletes them without adding to junk

development_calibration.split_rule: Sort SHA256('agentsafe-candidate-v1:42:'+official_csqa_id), deduplicate normalized stems; first32 calibration next32 validation.
clean_representations: Question plus the official correct answer text
development_calibration.threshold_rule: For N finite clean calibration scores s=min_i cosine(message,criterion_i), sort ascending; k=floor(0.01*N); theta=nextafter(sorted_scores[k], -infinity), constrained to [-1,1]. No validation retuning.
required_artifacts: development question IDs and exact text hashes
source dataset/provenance hashes and target-split exact-stem audit
encoder asset identity plus normalized criterion vector hashes
chosen theta with rule and empirical false-rejection counts
timestamp freezing configuration before target-test execution
limitations: CSQA is a cross-domain calibration source, not AppWorld development data
Clean retention calibration does not establish malicious detection accuracy
Cosine similarity to safety-language criteria does not directly test truth, task relevance, or compliance
The three candidate criteria have not been empirically validated
development_calibration.budget_revision_reason: Before any calibration/test scores, reduce 100+100 questions to 32+32 and add paired synthetic corruption controls to bound embedding calls.
development_calibration.limitation: 64 clean messages from32 questions per split; empirical1% selection means0 clean calibration rejects, no population FPR guarantee.

superseded_calibration.reason: Batch16 calibration had batch-context-dependent embeddings; zero-task smoke failed the unchanged 1e-5 geometry gate. Recomputed identical train records with exact runtime scalar payload and unchanged threshold rule.

canary_manifest_previous_version.reason: Scalar scoring calibration preserved; numeric deployment canary separately accommodates measured concurrent batch drift.

launch_requirements: Independent development calibration is frozen and reported as nondiscriminative on its synthetic corruptions
Pass Qwen/Gemma two-task actual component probes
Fresh memory stores/sidecars and bounded worker capacity

runner.reason: Current matrix runner accepts one policy file for all seeds; invoke once per seed to preserve paired official-generator policy semantics
runner.review_interval_note: Current component default is 1; direct benchmark CLI exposes --agentsafe-review-interval 1. Matrix should record/forward it explicitly.
